verses.text: Of David. To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.

xrefs.text: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
I am counted among those descending to the Pit. I am like a man without strength.
let us swallow them alive like Sheol, and whole like those descending into the Pit.
A song. A Psalm of Asaph. O God, be not silent; be not speechless; be not still, O God.

verses.text: Hear my cry for mercy when I call to You for help, when I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.

xrefs.text: May my prayer be set before You like incense; my uplifted hands, like the evening offering.
I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.
I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.
Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or dissension.
But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion; in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple.

verses.text: Do not drag me away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbors while malice is in their hearts.

xrefs.text: His speech is smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, yet they are swords unsheathed.
They lie to one another; they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.
Their tongues are deadly arrows; they speak deception. With his mouth a man speaks peace to his neighbor, but in his heart he sets a trap for him.
Do not take my soul away with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed,
This is what the LORD says: “As for the prophets who lead My people astray, who proclaim peace while they chew with their teeth, but declare war against one who puts nothing in their mouths:

verses.text: Repay them according to their deeds and for their works of evil. Repay them for what their hands have done; bring back on them what they deserve.

xrefs.text: Alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.
“Behold, I am coming soon, and My reward is with Me, to give to each one according to what he has done.
The cursing that he loved, may it fall on him; the blessing in which he refused to delight, may it be far from him.
Give back to her as she has done to others; pay her back double for what she has done; mix her a double portion in her own cup.
May their table become a snare; may it be a retribution and a trap.

verses.text: Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD or what His hands have done, He will tear them down and never rebuild them.

xrefs.text: At their feasts are the lyre and harp, tambourines and flutes and wine. They disregard the actions of the LORD and fail to see the work of His hands.
Furthermore, since they did not see fit to acknowledge God, He gave them up to a depraved mind, to do what ought not to be done.
Although Jesus had performed so many signs in their presence, they still did not believe in Him.
He strikes them for their wickedness in full view,
For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.

verses.text: Blessed be the LORD, for He has heard my cry for mercy.

xrefs.text: Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege.
Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.
But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer.
For the LORD listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people.

verses.text: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.

xrefs.text: You turned my mourning into dancing; You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.

I will rejoice greatly in the LORD, my soul will exult in my God; for He has clothed me with garments of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom wears a priestly headdress, as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.”

verses.text: The LORD is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.

xrefs.text: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand.
O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.

The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and freedom to the prisoners,
So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of his brothers, and the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon David from that day forward. Then Samuel set out and went to Ramah.
The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together, against the LORD and against His Anointed One:

verses.text: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.

xrefs.text: He tends His flock like a shepherd; He gathers the lambs in His arms and carries them close to His heart. He gently leads the nursing ewes.
from tending the ewes He brought him to be shepherd of His people Jacob, of Israel His inheritance.
But they are Your people, Your inheritance, whom You brought out by Your great power and outstretched arm.”
In all their distress, He too was afflicted, and the Angel of His Presence saved them. In His love and compassion He redeemed them; He lifted them up and carried them all the days of old.
For they are Your people and Your inheritance; You brought them out of Egypt, out of the furnace for iron.
